qa_preflight.notes: Preflight: valida env vars, app URL reachability, DB tables, QA users. No browser, no DB write. Runner: npx tsx (tsx needed for generated/prisma/client .ts import).

qa_login_server_side.notes: Server-side login: bcrypt password hash validation + profile checks (isSeller, role, isBanned). SESSION_BROWSER_REQUIRED for actual cookie verification.
qa_login_server_side.status: IMPLEMENTED — buyer/seller login via bcrypt + Prisma. Admin only if QA_ADMIN_* envs present.

qa_publish_listing.notes: Server-side listing create/reconcile via Prisma direct mutation (no session-based createListing() server action needed). Creates slug=qa-e2e-s03f-selleria-discovery.
qa_publish_listing.status: IMPLEMENTED — creates/updates listing via Prisma, verifies ACTIVE in DB

qa_home_discovery.notes: Two-phase: DB read verifies listing ACTIVE (DATA_DISCOVERY_PASS). HTTP fetch of /marketplace verifies server-rendered HTML presence (UI_PASS). Falls back to BROWSER_REQUIRED for client-rendered UIs.
qa_home_discovery.status: IMPLEMENTED — DB + HTTP fetch discovery. Classifies DATA_PASS / UI_PASS / BROWSER_REQUIRED.

qa_purchase_initiation.notes: Server-side purchase initiation via Prisma direct mutation. Creates TX in PENDING_PAYMENT.
qa_purchase_initiation.status: IMPLEMENTED — creates/reuses TX, verifies PENDING_PAYMENT state

qa_payment_report.notes: Server-side payment report via Prisma direct. Updates TX to PAYMENT_RECEIVED with ref=QA-S03G-REF-001.
qa_payment_report.status: IMPLEMENTED — updates TX status, creates status history

qa_payment_proof.notes: Server-side proof attachment via Prisma direct (dummy blob metadata + TX update). Verifies admin/seller/buyer visibility. Browser-based file upload deferred to S03I with Playwright.
qa_payment_proof.status: IMPLEMENTED — blob metadata + TX update + visibility checks

qa_admin_review.notes: Server-side admin review: status flow verification, proof URL check. Lenient on final state (accepts any valid state in pipeline).
qa_admin_review.status: IMPLEMENTED — status flow + proof URL check + buyer/seller identity

qa_seller_delivery.notes: Server-side: inline admin validation (PAYMENT_RECEIVED -> IN_ESCROW) + seller delivery (seller_delivered event). No browser.
qa_seller_delivery.status: IMPLEMENTED — admin validate + seller deliver in one module

qa_buyer_receipt.notes: Server-side: buyer confirms delivery (IN_ESCROW -> DELIVERY_CONFIRMED). No browser.

qa_admin_payout.notes: Server-side: releaseEscrow (DELIVERY_CONFIRMED -> RELEASED) + MpPayout creation. No browser.
